meeting.title: Orbit launch readiness and staged rollout

segments.text: This is our fictional launch-readiness review. The October release remains scheduled for October 16.
The PayU integration passed the sandbox and production smoke tests. The integration is completed.
Offline mode passed the airplane-mode and reconnect tests. Offline mode is ready for release.
The side drawer passed the 56 dp touch-target and screen-reader checks. Navigation accessibility review is completed.
Decision: release to five percent of eligible users first. We will expand only after payments and crash metrics pass review.
I own the payment success dashboard. I will finish the launch monitoring checklist by Friday, October 16.
I own the rollback runbook and will publish it by October 16. The feature flag can disable the new payment flow.
I own the customer support guide. I will deliver the updated screenshots and known-issues page by Monday, October 19.
Decision: stop the rollout if payment success falls below 98 percent or crash-free sessions fall below 99.5 percent.
I own the pilot results review. I will approve or hold the 25 percent rollout on Tuesday, October 20.
